transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been having these... flashes, I guess. They come out of nowhere, like I’m back in that crowded holding room, seeing the fight and hearing people getting shoved against the wall. It even happens when I’m just standing at a pickup counter.
Are these flashes usually triggered by something specific happening around you?

Yeah... sometimes. Crowded places, mostly. Like if I’m waiting at a pickup counter and people are close in, it just kind of hits me—like I’m back in that holding room again, seeing the fight and people getting shoved against the wall. It feels sudden.
Do you find yourself avoiding places or situations that remind you of the holding room or the fight?

Yeah. I’ve been... avoiding that whole area. I turn down night runs if they take me near the detention building, and I’ll take the long way around town just so I don’t have to pass it. Even talking about it too much makes me feel like I’m right back there.
Do you have trouble sleeping at night?

Yeah. I barely sleep. I’ll maybe doze off for an hour or two, then I’m up again from some dream about that cell… or a door slamming. By morning I’m just wrecked, like I shouldn’t even be driving my route.
Do you often find yourself being easily startled by small noises or movements?

Yeah. More than I want to admit. A radio crackle, a siren, even a door slamming... I jump like someone’s coming at me. Then my heart just keeps going, and sometimes I have to pull over or step outside for a minute.
Do you ever feel like you're observing yourself from outside your body or like you're in a daze during these flashes?
I... I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve noticed it like that. It’s more just confusing and hard to stay with what’s happening, but I don’t know about being outside my body.
Do you ever feel like you're in a daze or disconnected from what's happening around you when you're not having one of these flashes?
I don’t know. Not really something I’ve paid attention to. Sometimes I’m just… not fully there, I guess, but I can’t tell if that’s what you mean.
Do you ever feel like you're in a daze or disconnected from what's happening around you when you're not having one of these flashes?
I guess... I still don’t really know. Maybe I zone out sometimes, but I haven’t noticed it as being disconnected exactly. It’s hard to say.
Do you feel numb or detached from yourself or your surroundings when you're not having one of these flashes?
I don’t really know. I mean… numb, maybe sometimes, but I haven’t really thought of it that way. I mostly just feel off, I guess. Hard to explain.
Are there any specific activities or things you used to enjoy that you've stopped doing because they might remind you of the holding room or the fight?

Yeah… I guess. I’ve been turning down the night runs. And I take the long way around town now, just so I don’t have to go near that detention building. I don’t really talk about what happened either… it just brings it all back too much.
Have you been avoiding people or social interactions because of what happened?

Yeah… kind of. I’ve been keeping to myself more. I turn down the night runs, and I go the long way so I don’t have to pass that building. Talking about it with people just… makes it feel like I’m back there, so I mostly don’t.
Have you lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?
I don’t know… maybe. I haven’t really been doing much lately, but I’m not sure if it’s because I don’t enjoy it or I just don’t feel like dealing with anything.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy doing?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been doing much, but I don’t know if I’d call it losing interest. It’s just… hard to say.
Have you noticed yourself having less interest in hobbies or activities that were important to you before the incident in the holding room?
I’m not sure. I mean… I haven’t really been doing those things, but I can’t tell if I care less about them or if I’m just not up for much right now.
Have you found that you no longer enjoy activities that were once very important to you?
I don’t know. I haven’t really tried much, honestly… so I can’t say if I don’t enjoy it anymore or if I’m just avoiding everything.
Do you feel like you no longer enjoy things that you used to find pleasure in?
I can’t really tell. I haven’t been doing much of anything, so… I don’t know if I don’t enjoy it or if I just haven’t gotten myself to try.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy doing since the incident in the holding room?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been doing much since then, so it’s hard to say if I lost interest or just… haven’t gone near any of it.
Have you noticed that you no longer find pleasure in activities that were once very important to you?
I’m not sure. I guess I haven’t really put myself in a position to find out. I just… haven’t been doing those things much.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy doing since the incident in the holding room?
I don’t know. I mean… I haven’t really tried doing much of that stuff since then, so I can’t say if it’s lost interest or just me avoiding it.
